verses.text: For the choir director; [set to] El Shoshannim; Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph. Oh, give ear, Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You who are enthroned [above] the cherubim, shine forth!
verses.textZh: （亞薩的詩，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。）領約瑟如領羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心聽！坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你發出光來！

verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Your power And come to save us!
verses.textZh: 在以法蓮、便雅憫、瑪拿西前面施展你的大能，來救我們。

verses.text: O God, restore us And cause Your face to shine [upon us], and we will be saved.
verses.textZh: 神啊，求你使我們回轉（或譯：復興），使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！

verses.text: O LORD God [of] hosts, How long will You be angry with the prayer of Your people?
verses.textZh: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，你向你百姓的禱告發怒，要到幾時呢？

verses.text: You have fed them with the bread of tears, And You have made them to drink tears in large measure.
verses.textZh: 你以眼淚當食物給他們吃，又多量出眼淚給他們喝。

verses.text: You make us an object of contention to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.textZh: 你使鄰邦因我們紛爭；我們的仇敵彼此戲笑。

verses.text: O God [of] hosts, restore us And cause Your face to shine [upon us], and we will be saved.
verses.textZh: 萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！

verses.text: You removed a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and planted it.
verses.textZh: 你從埃及挪出一棵葡萄樹，趕出外邦人，把這樹栽上。

verses.text: You cleared [the ground] before it, And it took deep root and filled the land.
verses.textZh: 你在這樹根前預備了地方，他就深深扎根，爬滿了地。

verses.text: The mountains were covered with its shadow, And the cedars of God with its boughs.
verses.textZh: 他的影子遮滿了山，枝子好像佳美的香柏樹。

verses.text: It was sending out its branches to the sea And its shoots to the River.
verses.textZh: 他發出枝子，長到大海，發出蔓子，延到大河。

verses.text: Why have You broken down its hedges, So that all who pass [that] way pick its [fruit]?
verses.textZh: 你為何拆毀這樹的籬笆，任憑一切過路的人摘取？

verses.text: A boar from the forest eats it away And whatever moves in the field feeds on it.
verses.textZh: 林中出來的野豬把他糟踏；野地的走獸拿他當食物。

verses.text: O God [of] hosts, turn again now, we beseech You; Look down from heaven and see, and take care of this vine,
verses.textZh: 萬軍之神啊，求你回轉！從天上垂看，眷顧這葡萄樹，

verses.text: Even the shoot which Your right hand has planted, And on the son whom You have strengthened for Yourself.
verses.textZh: 保護你右手所栽的和你為自已所堅固的枝子。

verses.text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
verses.textZh: 這樹已經被火焚燒，被刀砍伐；他們因你臉上的怒容就滅亡了。

verses.text: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.
verses.textZh: 願你的手扶持你右邊的人，就是你為自已所堅固的人子。

verses.text: Then we shall not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.textZh: 這樣，我們便不退後離開你；求你救活我們，我們就要求告你的名。

verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, restore us; Cause Your face to shine [upon us], and we will be saved.
verses.textZh: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，求你使我們回轉，使你的臉發光，我們便要得救！
